title: Grassy field room- red door
content: Hi Mall World friends- I am hoping anyone that may have been to the location I describe before might want to try to meet up there this week via dream scape. It is a sprawling area with green rolling hills and there is just a solitary red door next to a tree. I run and run and never reach the door. It is my biggest goal to get through- I have convinced myself it opens out to the astral plane. Let me know what you think
